column1: # tools/isa-census.tsv -- the adjudication half of `R1-pub-0`'s census.
# `tools/isacensus.py` derives the POPULATION from two instruments and checks
# this table against it in both directions.  What is adjudicated here is the
# EVIDENCE, per row, on four routes:
#   r1  量 on the die, by a payload of ours, under a handler of ours.
#   r2  量 on the die INDIRECTLY -- code that has run on this part contains
#       the encoding and the boot completes with no exception message.  Usually
#       that code is the loader's or the vendor kernel's; on exactly one row it
#       is an image of THIS project's, and that row is the sharpest instance of
#       what route 2 cannot see.  `SPEC.md` `CPU-17` carries this exact mark.
#   r3  讀 vendor material only: the assembler's per-`-march` answer, a Kconfig
#       knob, a count in a binary.  Never the die.
#   (a row with all three `.` is route 4 -- no evidence of any class)
# `route` in the report is the STRONGEST route present, and `seat` may be named
# only where r1 is `y` (`isacensus check` K6/K7 enforce both directions).
# For an `r1b` row, r2 is evidence that the SHAPE executes on this die.
# It is never evidence that the hazard is absent -- see the
# document's § 2.2.  `SPEC.md` `CPU-31` says so in its own words.
# A `declared` row is one no instrument derives.  It must carry a
# `path:token` cite that is still present in that file, or the population
# would be tunable by whoever edits this table.
# Tab separated.  No `|` in any cell: the note column is rendered into a
# markdown table and `spec-check`'s C8 counts cells by pipe.
